جَرِيشٌ A thing, (S, K,) such as salt, (A,) bruised, brayed, or pounded, (S, A, K,) and ground, (A,) coarsely, not finely: (S, A, K:) or, applied to salt, it signifies مَالَمْ يُطَيَّبْ [app. meaning such as has not been purified], (S, K, TA,) that crumbles; as though one part thereof were rubbed against another. (TA.) ―
-b2- Also Coarse flour, such as is fit for [making the kind of food called] خَبِيص مُرَمَّل. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
